fields.name: SqlConnectionPropertiesBase SQL Server connection-property values
fields.description: The independently optional SQL Server connection attributes carried by SqlConnectionPropertiesBase.

members.name: ApplicationIntent
members.description: Availability-group workload type.

members.name: ApplicationName
members.description: Application name supplied during connection initiation.

members.name: ConnectTimeout
members.description: Seconds to wait for a server connection attempt before it terminates.

members.name: CurrentLanguage
members.description: SQL Server language record name.

members.name: DataSource
members.description: SQL Server instance name or network address.

members.name: Encrypt
members.description: Whether client-server traffic requests SSL encryption.

members.name: FailoverPartner
members.description: Partner server name or address used when the primary server is down.

members.name: InitialCatalog
members.description: Database associated with the connection.

members.name: LoadBalanceTimeout
members.description: Minimum seconds that a pooled connection remains alive before destruction.

members.name: MaxPoolSize
members.description: Maximum connections allowed in this connection string's pool.

members.name: MinPoolSize
members.description: Minimum connections allowed in this connection string's pool.

members.name: MultipleActiveResultSets
members.description: Whether a connection permits more than one active result set.

members.name: MultiSubnetFailover
members.description: Whether availability-group connection detection uses multi-subnet failover.

members.name: PacketSize
members.description: Network packet size in bytes.

members.name: PersistSecurityInfo
members.description: Whether security-sensitive connection information remains returnable after the connection is opened.

members.name: Pooling
members.description: Whether requested connections are pooled rather than explicitly opened each time.

members.name: Replication
members.description: Whether the connection supports replication.

members.name: TransactionBinding
members.description: How the connection associates with an enlisted System.Transactions transaction.

members.name: TrustServerCertificate
members.description: Whether an encrypted channel bypasses certificate-chain trust validation.

members.name: TypeSystemVersion
members.description: Type system expected by the application.

members.name: UserInstance
members.description: Whether SQL Server Express redirects to a caller-owned runtime instance.

members.name: WorkstationID
members.description: Workstation name supplied to SQL Server.

representations.CSharp: Nullable value types and nullable strings exposed as public properties on SqlConnectionPropertiesBase.
